description: Execute one 765T Flow catalog tool by its exact name. `arguments` is exactly the arguments a direct call to that tool carries — the advertised input schema flow_tools answers for it, including the reserved members (instanceId always; documentKey where the tool is document-scoped; optional idempotencyKey and dryRun). Read the schema with flow_tools first; names never resolve by similarity.

arguments.description: The tool's own advertised arguments plus the reserved call members

tool.description: The exact catalog tool name (a hub tool name is refused)

name: flow_call
title: Run a catalog tool
